labelChirho: to be right, be assessed as just
descriptionChirho: Nifal: to be measured and found right or just, to be assessed properly; used of God's and human ways in Ezekiel and of actions being weighed in 1 Samuel 2:3
Qal active participle: to weigh hearts or spirits, to evaluate and examine (Prov 16:2; 21:2; 24:12)
Piel: to measure or mark off physical quantities such as waters, heavens, and wind (Isa 40:12-13; Job 28:25)
Piel: to set in order, make firm or stable; used of God establishing the pillars of the earth (Ps 75:3)
Pual passive participle: money or silver that has been weighed out, measured for payment (2 Kgs 12:11)
